trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression at the lobe convergence, approximately 55-degree angular intercept, partially occluded by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular macro-serrations (5-15 pixel peaks) caused by calcified clusters; left lobe trailing edge displays lower-amplitude, moderate-frequency micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe exhibits a short, highly convex distal arc; left lobe exhibits a prolonged, predominantly linear trajectory with a subtle terminal concavity toward the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity (white/beige) textured pixels localized at the distal tips of both lobes and along the posterior margin of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral calcified barnacle encrustation creating a jagged, thickened boundary along the trailing edges and terminal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Partial obscuration of the fluke-peduncle interface by turbulent white-water splash and surface wake.
